rationale: The agent verified identity properly using full name + ZIP and matched to a single user before sharing order details or making changes. It used read-only tools to inspect the user’s orders and pulled the tracking number for the order it checked, then sought clarification when the user indicated a Texas shipment. For the return request, the agent verified the order contents (noting no pet bed), asked for explicit confirmation to return the skateboard, and only then submitted the return via the appropriate tool. The tool response showed the order status updated to return requested with refund to the original PayPal method, which the agent communicated accurately. No unsupported claims, no actions on another user, and no writes without confirmation. Minor caveat: the agent did not proactively search all orders for a Texas shipment before giving the initial tracking number, but it did request clarification and did not disclose other orders improperly. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
